response.sql: WITH global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as global_average FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_average FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), above_avg_stations AS (SELECT sa.station_average, (sa.station_average - ga.global_average) as diff_from_avg FROM station_avg sa CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE sa.station_average > ga.global_average) SELECT AVG(station_average) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(diff_from_avg) as mean_above_average FROM above_avg_stations
